test_title: SSC CGL 2021 Tier-I (Held On : 20 April 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

X _ U _ B _ O _ Z _ X _ U _ B

options.text: O Z X U B O Z
O Z X U B Z O
O X Z U B O Z
O Z X B U O Z

solution:
Given: X _ U _ B _ O _ Z _ X _ U _ B

 
• O Z X U B O Z → X **O** U **Z** B - **X** O **U** Z **B -** X **O** U **Z** B
 
• O Z X U B Z O → X O U Z B - X O U Z B - X **Z** U **O** B
 
• O X Z U B O Z → X O U **X** B - **Z** O U Z B - X O U Z B
 
• O Z X B U O Z → X O U Z B - X O **B** Z **U** - X O U Z B

Option 1) followed the cycle of XOUZB

Hence, the correct answer is **"O Z X U B O Z".**
